name: Scotch Plains Recreation Day Camp
description_short: Township recreation day camp in Scotch Plains for children entering kindergarten through grade 6, with a separate Small Fry camp in three sessions for ages 3 to 5. Registration runs through Community Pass.
notes: The 2026 page lists Day Camp (K to 6) and Small Fry Camp #1, #2 and #3 (ages 3 to 5), all closed for 2026 registration; refund requests were due by April 10, 2026. The page's camp sections are empty, so dates, place, hours and fees are not shown.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. 2026 summer camps page. ZIP and phone are the Recreation office's (430 Park Avenue, Town Hall Room 113). Age 3 is the Small Fry minimum; age 12 derived from grade 6
